text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After going out with Agnes Tachyon,
we had some tea before heading home—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Hmm...
Trainer, I've been thinking about this for a while.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
You look quite exhausted.
Are you managing your physical health properly?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Good grief, what an unreliable response.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
I'm heading to the lab now,
but you should go rest early.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: As I have said before, things evolve and change day by day.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
What you thought was right today
might yield the exact opposite answer tomorrow.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
If you let your guard down, knowledge will become
a thing of the past in the blink of an eye, turning into rigid stone.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Do you understand?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
In other words, physical transformation isn't a quick fix,
but a continuous pursuit of potential... is that right?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: "Come to think of it, someone once told me that 'medicine can make you faster.' Do you remember?"

text_block_list.name: Curly-Haired Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Please! Share that medicine with me!
I want to get faster...!

text_block_list.name: Curly-Haired Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
I keep losing all the time...
So I don't care if it's cheating anymore!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
I wonder. Do you understand the meaning
behind the experiment in the research I am conducting?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Agnes Tachyon's research aims to surpass
what are believed to be the limits of an Umamusume's power.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It should be proof of chasing endless possibilities
and making them certain.
If so—
choice_data_list: Maybe a way to find that spark?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Heh-heh! Excellent answer!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"My research! My experiments!
They are merely one way to approach my objective!"

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: I'm pleased to see that you, my guinea pig, understand so clearly. Keep up the good work going forward—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Suddenly, my body wobbled and tilted over.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Huh...?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Hey, what's wrong, Trainer—!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Agnes Tachyon's voice sounds distant.
Strength gradually drained from my entire body... and I collapsed right on the spot.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Oh, you're awake.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
We are in the dorm lobby.
Fret not, I have already obtained permission for you to enter.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It looks like Agnes Tachyon
was the one who carried it over.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"I can still move, but...
the exhaustion is overwhelming..."

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: "...I really should have urged them to go home the moment I noticed they weren't feeling well."

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Well, Trainer, you are also an invaluable test subject to me, after all." dialogue},
  {"id": 33, "en": "Well, that's 'cause I'm genuinely super happyâª

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: In other words, it would be troublesome if you became useless.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Maintain proper awareness of your role as a test subject and take good care of your health on a daily basis, if you will.

Agnes Tachyon was her usual self.
Even so, somewhere in her words, I felt a sense of appreciation... or perhaps I didn't.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"Is that true?
You still look quite pale to me, though."
She looked so terribly worried that I intended to make a joke just to cheer her up, but—
choice_data_list: Then cure me with your medicine.
Then please cure me with your medicine.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Huh...!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
...I see. I see, I see!
Well, well... that's wonderful to hear!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Splendid, what a delightful change of heart!
I just love a cooperative guinea pig!!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Come now, leave it to me!
Nutritional boost, explosive energy... I promise you'll get the exact results you asked for!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: —Even if it comes with a few superfluous side effects, well, that's just part of its charm.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: I ended up getting her a little too energized...
